intro: Build confidence in medical Spanish, one conversation at a time. Choose a specialty and keep learning at your own pace.
specialtiesSub: Fourteen specialties. One meaningful conversation at a time.
goalSub: Small steps add up. No lives, no pressure.
setupSub: Mix listening, vocabulary, and sentence building. Every answer is a chance to learn.

aboutText: MedLingo is an offline vocabulary and communication trainer. Content comes from attributed open data and authored teaching phrases. It is a language-learning resource, not a source of patient-specific medical advice.
sourceText: Wikidata contributors (CC0); MedlinePlus, U.S. National Library of Medicine (public-domain topic metadata, no endorsement); authored YAML (CC BY 4.0). DeCS and Wiktionary adapters are included; see the bank report for the sources actually present.
noVoice: No Spanish device voice is installed. Add Spanish speech in Windows Settings > Time & language > Speech, or macOS System Settings > Accessibility > Spoken Content. An available voice will be used.
